claim.claim-text: 1. An archery projectile locating facility comprising:

2. The locating facility according to claim 1, including a directional receiver (30) adapted to receive the plurality of data signals, such that the elongated body (20) may be located by a user with the directional receiver.
3. The locating facility according to claim 1 or 2, the sensor facility including a temperature sensor (52) adapted to generate temperature information on the elongated body (20).
4. The locating facility according to claim 3, wherein the transmitter (50) is adapted to transmit the temperature information as part of the plurality of data signals.

5. The locating facility according to claim 1 or 2, including an energy storage device (14) in electrical communication with the microcontroller (60) and the sensor facility, and wherein the sensor facility is operable to generate energy status information.
6. The locating facility according to claim 5, wherein the transmitter (50) is adapted to transmit the energy status information as part of the plurality of data signals.
7. The locating facility according to claim 1 or 2, the sensor facility including an acceleration sensor (62) adapted to generate movement information.
8. The locating facility according to claim 7, wherein the transmitter (50) is adapted to transmit the movement information as part of the plurality of data signals.
9. The locating facility according to claim 1, wherein the elongated body (20) includes a signal designator (28).
10. The locating facility according to claim 9, wherein the plurality of data signals are encrypted based on the signal designator (28).
11. The locating facility according to claim 10, wherein a directional receiver (30) is further adapted to decrypt the plurality of data signals through employment of the signal designator (28).
12. The locating facility according to claim 2, wherein the directional receiver (30) is further adapted to communicate at least one of the following to a remote computing device (36):
13. The locating facility according to claim 1, wherein each of the plurality of data signals is encoded based on a transmit power level.
14. The locating facility according to claim 13, wherein a directional receiver (30) is further adapted to decode the plurality of data signals.

15. The locating facility according to claim 1, wherein the first of the plurality of data signals is encoded with a first signal code, and the second of the plurality of data signals is encoded with a second signal code, the first signal code distinct from the second signal code.
